annotations.title: Asking rents, rent index, LHA, yield and mortgage rates

description:
Asking rents by bedroom band, the asking-rent index, the Local Housing
    Allowance rate, the area gross yield with its basis, and mortgage rates, as
    named sections (at most 30 rows). Default include is ["rents", "yield"]. area_type is postcode_district (lowercase, e.g. 'w14'), local_authority (GSS code,
    e.g. 'E09000012'), county or country; area_code is that code. Free text is refused: call
    resolve_place first.

    Gross yield is published at ALL-bedroom level only: when you ask for one
    band the yield is still the all-bedroom figure, and the reply says so; say it
    too. The `lha` section needs a full `postcode` (otherwise it is named as
    needs_postcode) and has no category above 4 bedrooms. A failed section is
    named and absent; the call is covered if any section answered.

    Do NOT use it to value a property or to appraise a deal. Free; covered=false
    or an upstream failure is not charged. Free.
name: rent_and_yield
